title: The only simulation is a finished series, with impossible framing
what_happened: Play shows one simulation: NBA Finals 2026, Game 6, SAS at NYK, 10,000 simulated games. The same card says NYK lead 4-1 and championship odds NYK 100.0%, so the series was already over, yet it still gives Game 6 win odds of 35.5% and 64.5%. Nothing says when it was computed. In October that makes me doubt every number on the page.
expected: Current simulations for upcoming games, each with the date it was run; an archived example clearly labeled as such

title: Margin chart has no y-axis and no date; heading says MONTA CARLO
what_happened: The Margin histogram has x-axis labels in 10-point steps but no y-axis, counts or percentages, and no note of the inputs. The card heading reads MONTA CARLO. A NYK blowout of 148 to 81 is listed as a notable simulation with no word on how often that happened.
expected: Labeled axes with units, a spelled-correctly Monte Carlo, frequencies for the notable outcomes, and a run date

title: Method is explained, but no calibration or track record is shown
what_happened: How MONTA CARLO works explains the 1-20 rating scale, the five attributes and a possession-by-possession simulation calibrated against real NBA data from 2025-26. Good. But it never shows how well the sim has predicted real games, how calibration was checked, or any error bars beyond the margin spread.
expected: A short track record or calibration note, such as how often 60% favorites actually won, so I can judge whether to trust the numbers

repro.step: tap "MONTA CARLO Matchup-Oriented N-Trial Analysis: Comparative Assessment of Randomized League Outcomes Pick any two NBA tea"

title: 16 ML bots and 213K games modeled are claimed but never shown
what_happened: The home page claims 16 ML bots to beat and 213K games modeled. Logged out, the only model output I found is one NBA Finals game from June and a hand-run matchup lab; Learn has four articles. No predictions for any upcoming game, and no page about the bots.
expected: At least a sample of the bots' current predictions or the modeled games, or the claim worded so it says these are for signed-in players

repro.step: tap "MONTA CARLO Matchup-Oriented N-Trial Analysis: Comparative Assessment of Randomized League Outcomes Pick any two NBA tea"
